definitions.rationale: This is the macro equation that expands numberKeyClosure to the exact closure value for the translated helper body; it defines a named proof term and does not perform or replace execution.
definitions.text:
rule numberKeyClosure
    => closureVal(
         ("number", .ParamNames),
         (Return(
            Call(
              Attribute(
                TupleExpr(
                  Str("zero"),
                  Str("one"),
                  Str("two"),
                  Str("three"),
                  Str("four"),
                  Str("five"),
                  Str("six"),
                  Str("seven"),
                  Str("eight"),
                  Str("nine")),
                "index"),
              Name("number"))) .Stmts),
         0)

definitions.rationale: This is the macro equation that expands sortNumbersClosure to the exact closure value for the translated target body; it defines a named proof term and does not perform or replace execution.
definitions.text:
rule sortNumbersClosure
    => closureVal(
         ("numbers", .ParamNames),
         (Return(
            Call(
              Attribute(Str(" "), "join"),
              Call(
                Name("sorted"),
                Call(Attribute(Name("numbers"), "split"), .Exprs),
                KwArg("key", Name("_number_key"))))) .Stmts),
         0)

definitions.rationale: This unconditional equation defines isNumberWord as equality with one of the ten permitted numeral-string values; it is the defining equation of a total domain predicate, not an additional fact about an existing symbol.
definitions.text:
rule isNumberWord(V)
    => V ==K str(strToCodes("zero"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("one"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("two"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("three"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("four"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("five"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("six"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("seven"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("eight"))
       orBool V ==K str(strToCodes("nine"))

definitions.rationale: This equation is the empty-sequence base case of the structural definition of allNumberWords.
This equation is the constructor-recursive case of allNumberWords, defining the predicate by checking the head and recurring on the strict tail.
definitions.text:
rule allNumberWords(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => isNumberWord(V) andBool allNumberWords(REST)

definitions.rationale: This unconditional equation defines expectedSortNumbers as the named composition of splitWS, sortKeyVS, and joinCodes; it abbreviates the symbolic result and does not assert an extra property of those operations.
definitions.text:
rule expectedSortNumbers(CS)
    => str(
         joinCodes(
           strToCodes(" "),
           sortKeyVS(
             splitWS(CS, .IntSeq, .ValSeq),
             numberKeyClosure)))
